description: This file defines the AccountsViewDetail class, which extends ViewDetail to customize the detail view for the Accounts module in SugarCRM. It includes methods for displaying account details, generating push code for address copying, and managing UI interactions.

classes.name: AccountsViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail to customize the account detail view, including methods for display and generating address push code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the default display method to include custom behavior such as popup HTML, process display variable, permission checks, and rendering the view.

methods.name: generatePushCode
methods.description: Generates HTML code for a button that opens a contact popup to copy address information into contacts.
